README: Persistent import pins for scripts/import-pms.mjs. COMMITTED — these must survive the monthly APMI fetch.
A pin says: this CSV row belongs to THIS Sanity document, stop asking. It exists for strategies whose names
are too close for the matcher to separate safely, where guessing would overwrite the wrong document.
Keyed by the normalised (manager, strategyName) pair, so punctuation and abbreviation drift do not break a pin.
To fill in a sanityId, run the importer's dry run — it prints a paste-ready entry for every ambiguous row,
Pick the right candidate, paste the block into "pins" below, and commit it.
An entry with an empty sanityId is reported as UNRESOLVED and is never applied — it only records that the row
is known to be ambiguous. An entry that matches no CSV row is reported as UNMATCHED, which usually means the
manager renamed the strategy: re-run the dry run and update the entry.
